scope: Reusable extra attack Energy requirement: authoritative current cost, disjoint units and copied attacks

sources.finding: Counter Gain reduces the extra-Energy threshold for Electivire ex's LLC attack: four Lightning suffice. It cannot reduce Deoxys's PPP attack: four Psychic do not suffice for its two-extra-Energy clause.

Grimmsnarl VMAX with five Darkness under Wonder Labyrinth or Goomy's Sticky Membrane does 220. Marshadow copying G-Max Drill with one Psychic and two Darkness does 170, using all three Energy for its own copying cost.
Ninetales V copying Altered Creation GX with two Fire and one Water does not receive the extra effect: its own three-Energy cost including Fire must be met in addition to another Water.
Grimmsnarl VMAX G-Max Drill adds 50 for each extra Darkness Energy, capped at two extra units.
